entry.title: November 04, 2026
entry.content:
Feature

Direct Iceberg access in AlloyDB for PostgreSQL is available for PostgreSQL 18 and later (in Preview). This feature lets you query Apache Iceberg tables in Cloud Storage or Lakehouse runtime catalog and accelerate analytical queries using the AlloyDB columnar engine.

For more information, see Access Iceberg data from AlloyDB.

Feature

Syncing data from BigQuery into AlloyDB is generally available (GA). This feature lets you copy or mirror analytical tables from BigQuery into AlloyDB for low-latency operational access using the alloydb_sync extension.

For more information, see Sync BigQuery data to AlloyDB.

Feature

AlloyDB Express is available in Preview for PostgreSQL 18. Optimized for rapid prototyping and for workflows that use AI coding agents, this configuration provides the following features:

  • Fast provisioning
  • Scale-to-zero compute when idle
  • A monthly free tier for the first 12 months of usage
  • One-click upgrades to AlloyDB for PostgreSQL

For more information, see AlloyDB Express overview.

entry.title: November 03, 2026
entry.content:
Change

AlloyDB for PostgreSQL now defaults to PostgreSQL major version 18 for new clusters.

entry.title: November 02, 2026
entry.content:
Feature

You can now tune SQL queries using AI. Available starting with version 1.6.2 of the google_ml_integration extension, the ai.tune_sql function uses an LLM along with query execution plans, schemas, and runtime stats to recommend query optimizations. The function identifies performance bottlenecks and provides recommendations for query rewrites, indexes, statistics collection, Grand Unified Configuration (GUC) flags, and table analyze and vacuum operations. This feature is in Preview.

For more information, see Tune SQL queries using AI and Database advisor flags.
